settings.title: Build your perfect bundle
settings.description: Create an interactive bundle builder experience for routines, gift sets, or curated product combinations that feels premium and easy to shop.
settings.bullets:
Choose 3 or build-a-box flows
Routine or bundle recommendations
Upsell and cross-sell opportunities
settings.cards: Flexible selection | Let shoppers choose from complementary products. ||Higher AOV | Encourage larger baskets with curated combinations. ||Great for gift sets | Support routines, bundles, and seasonal collections.
settings.secondary_description: Bundle pages encourage customers to explore more and buy with confidence when the combinations feel curated rather than random.
